Marginal Cost (MC) = Total Cost at Q\(_3\) −Total Cost at Q\(_2\)

Given data from the table:

Total Cost at Quantity 2 (2TC\(_2\)​) = 1310 N

Total Cost at Quantity 3 (3TC\(_3\)​) = 1650 N

MC = TC\(_3​\) − TC\(_2\) ​= 1650N − 1310N = 340N
